title: A 100 mph Train Slammed Into a Nuclear Flask. The Flask Won

scenes.text: They crashed a 100 mph train into a nuclear waste flask.
scenes.keywords: train crash test high speed locomotive

scenes.text: It was 1984 in England. A driverless 140-ton locomotive pulling three carriages hit the 50-ton steel flask head on.
The locomotive was almost completely destroyed.
The flask started with 100 pounds of pressure. It lost less than one third of one pound.
It was a public test, to show these flasks survive a crash. The train lost. The flask won.

description:
In 1984 engineers deliberately smashed a 100 mph locomotive into a spent nuclear fuel flask to prove it could survive.
The driverless 140-ton locomotive and three carriages were almost completely destroyed. The 50-ton flask lost about 0.29 pounds of its 100 pounds of pressure.
Would you have watched this test in person?
first_comment: Which would you bet on: the 140-ton locomotive or the 50-ton flask? Be honest, did you pick the flask?
